Investors on the Nigerian Exchange Limited opened the week with a gain of N351.06bn on Monday, following renewed buying interest in industrial, consumer goods and insurance stocks. At the close of trading, the benchmark All-Share Index appreciated by 540.64 basis points, or 0.21 per cent, to settle at 252,809.78 points, up from 252,269.14 points recorded at the close of trading on Friday. Similarly, the total market capitalisation rose 0.21 per cent from N163.80tn to close at N164.15tn. Market breadth closed positive, with 34 gainers outpacing 27 losers across the equities board. Nigerian Exchange Group Plc led the gainers’ chart after its share price surged 10.00 per cent to close at N182.60 per share, up from N166.00. LivingTrust Mortgage Bank Plc followed with a 9.87 per cent gain to close at N2.56 per share, while Champion Breweries Plc advanced 9.82 per cent to settle at N12.30. Fortis Global Insurance Plc rose 9.64 per cent to N1.82 per share, and International Breweries Plc gained 9.52 per cent to close at N9.20. On the flip side, R. T. Briscoe (Nigeria) Plc topped the losers’ table, shedding 9.84 per cent to close at N8.25 per share from N9.15. Livestock Feeds Plc trailed with a 9.69 per cent decline to N11.65 per share, while eTranzact International Plc lost 5.88 per cent to settle at N16.00. Abbey Mortgage Bank Plc fell 5.80 per cent to N6.50 per share, and Veritas Kapital Assurance Plc dropped 4.59 per cent to close at N1.04. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. The NGX Consumer Goods Index led sectoral gains with a 0.80 per cent rise to 3,967.22 points, followed by the NGX Industrial Index, which climbed 0.60 per cent to 12,454.93 points. The NGX Growth Index rose 0.55 per cent to 26,605.34 points, the NGX Premium Index added 0.38 per cent to reach 33,407.59 points, and the NGX Insurance Index edged up by 0.25 per cent to 1,074.98 points. Access Holdings records N129.5m insider share sale Lasaco Assurance granted one-year free-float extension NGX gives Lasaco until 2027 to meet free float requirement Conversely, the NGX Banking Index dipped 0.26 per cent to 2,358.83 points due to sell-offs in Fidelity Bank Plc, United Bank for Africa Plc and Guaranty Trust Holding Company Plc, while the NGX Oil and Gas Index declined 0.10 per cent to 5,928.77 points following a drop in Oando Plc. Overall trading activity in the equities market recorded a total turnover of 673.59 million shares exchanged across 38,218 deals. Access Holdings Plc emerged as the most actively traded stock by volume, accounting for 203.62 million shares across 1,488 deals. FCMB Group Plc followed with 73.78 million shares traded in 430 deals, while Guaranty Trust Holding Company Plc recorded 45.45 million shares across 2,695 deals. Abbey Mortgage Bank Plc and Zenith Bank Plc completed the top five-volume drivers with 42.91 million shares and 31.36 million shares traded, respectively. In the Exchange-Traded Products segment, 324,450 units were traded across 1,251 deals. Lotus Halal Equity ETF led the gainers in that category with a 5.96 per cent increase to close at N136.69, whereas Stanbic IBTC ETF 30 posted the sharpest loss, declining 7.57 per cent to N940.00. Meanwhile, the debt market recorded 16 deals for 44,818 units across non-interest sovereign and corporate sukuk instruments.
